protocol.authorization: User approved documentation and execution of reproduction, guardrails, K0/T0 diagnostics and improvement experiments
protocol.fixed_rules: Unchanged split_v1, catalog, account reservations/quarantine/singletons, positive-only equal-weight scoring, all observed input exclusions, one hidden target, positive-score top10, no filling, full-user denominator
protocol.tail_guard: target train support 1-999; fixed using train counts, not frank distribution
protocol.game_macro: Equal mean over target-game means among games represented in fixed validation; report games and sample sizes; not all-catalog performance

selection.primary: whole-validation NDCG@10 versus the same-family v1
selection.automatic_adoption: Positive paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound for NDCG delta; no point-estimate loss in whole Recall, target-game-macro NDCG or tail NDCG; no increase in empty users
selection.otherwise: Retain v1 as conservative default and separately report best primary candidate and failed guards
selection.tie_break: If metric deltas indistinguishable prefer smaller K, fewer features and fewer channels
selection.cost: Report measured evaluation/build elapsed time, artifact bytes and feature/edge counts; coverage and short lists are reported with tradeoffs

bootstrap.method: Paired users, percentile 95%; equivalent multinomial resampling of the joint baseline/candidate rank table; post-selection uncertainty only, not independent confirmation

item_knn.selection_order: Report lambda=0 K1 first, then fixed-K K2; verify all predeclared K x lambda combinations to expose interaction; reselect from raw cooccurrences after shrinkage

tfidf.max_df_gate: T0 must show high-document-frequency terms contributing to wrong ranks; record gate decision before T3 ranking metrics
tfidf.metadata: A valid tags first, C tags fallback, C genres; concept-level binary presence then IDF/L2; separate channel
tfidf.missing_channels: zero contribution without per-user/candidate weight renormalization
tfidf.description_selection: Freeze selected text-only model before metadata weight comparison

protocol.test_policy: No v2 frank parameter search. Freeze validation selection and hashes first; any later fixed-model frank run is previously-observed reference evaluation, never new independent confirmation.
protocol.v1_policy: Do not edit frozen v1 scoring/evaluator/builder/protocol/model/split artifacts. Use new versioned code and paths. Record mutable source manifest snapshot at experiment start; source hashes refer to that timestamp.

result.source_manifest_note: Training hash refers to training-time state; current completion flags are mutable. Actual pinned train files are checked by builder.

retrospective_text_similarity.method: max frozen description cosine between held-out target and any remaining positive query; post-hoc diagnostic only

top10_hit_union.note: Oracle union of original top10 hits, not measured fusion performance or a bound on all possible score fusion

top10_hit_union.note: Oracle union of original top10 hits, not measured fusion performance or a bound on all possible score fusion

unreproduced_original_definition: Original custom 21-stopword list/formula absent: do not claim exact reconstruction. T0 uses explicitly named documented terms.
Original validation cosine sample seed and sampling rule absent: no claim to reproduce 3.4% on the same sample.

item_knn.note: Descriptive standardization only, not causal attribution. Train-support-zero has no validation observation and is assigned 0 for this approximation. Never used to weight validation selection.

tfidf.note: Descriptive standardization only, not causal attribution. Train-support-zero has no validation observation and is assigned 0 for this approximation. Never used to weight validation selection.

result.purpose: Reproducible train-only KNN reachability diagnosis; frank test is descriptive only
result.fit_scope: Pinned split_v1 train positive catalog only

category_definitions.target_support0: Hidden target has zero positive train support.
category_definitions.all_positive_inputs_support0: Every positive query input has zero positive train support; retained K100 coverage is a separate diagnostic.
category_definitions.raw_connection0: Target has no raw train co-occurrence with any positive query input.
category_definitions.pruned: At least one raw target/input link exists, but none survive v1 candidate top100.
category_definitions.rank_failure: At least one target/input link survives v1 top100, but saved v1 target rank is zero.
category_definitions.hit: Saved v1 target rank is between 1 and 10.

result.cooccurrence_semantics: All positive train users, including singleton positive users; raw edges exclude self-pairs.

validation.diagnostic_role: descriptive K0 cause analysis; not used for model selection or tuning

test.diagnostic_role: descriptive K0 cause analysis; not used for model selection or tuning

decision_rule_fixed_before_v2_experiment.build_T3_when: Aggregate contribution share from terms with document frequency >50% of the full fixed text catalog is at least 5% of all sampled wrong-top recommendation overlap in positive-rank-failure cases.
decision_rule_fixed_before_v2_experiment.historical_stopword_21_list: unavailable; this gate uses document frequency, not the unrecoverable historical stopword list
decision_rule_fixed_before_v2_experiment.sample_basis: fixed-seed T0 positive-rank-failure examples; same selected examples and exact profile-times-candidate term products as T0 report

method_definitions.historical_stop_words: The earlier 21-word list is absent. The report carries the recorded scikit-learn English stop word set as a new separate diagnostic and does not claim the old statistic is reproduced.
method_definitions.script_profile: Observed Unicode script blocks only; not an automatic language identification result.

support_log_buckets.ties: integer support counts are assigned to the half-open label ranges encoded by these fixed edges

method_definitions.token_percentiles: numpy.quantile(method='linear'); upper group is strictly greater than the threshold; every game tied at the boundary stays in the lower group and no tie is split by App ID. Inclusive-boundary sensitivity is also reported.

stopword_definition.comparison_population: four most frequently recommended Linux candidate games across all saved v1 validation Top 10 slots
stopword_definition.historical_21_word_set: not available in saved source artifacts; historical 21-word statistic is not claimed as reproduced
stopword_definition.weight_share: sum squared L2-normalized TF-IDF weights for listed words divided by total squared TF-IDF weight in each game vector

comparison_to_prior_backlog_recording.interpretation: Strictly greater than the linear p80 cutoff with boundary ties kept below reproduces the previously recorded 46.1% to rounding; the inclusive-boundary sensitivity is reported separately.

token_count_candidate_group.metric: share of saved v1 Top 10 recommendation slots assigned to Linux candidates in the token-count upper group
token_count_candidate_group.ties: all games equal to the threshold remain below the upper group; never split a tie by App ID

sampling.sampling_rule: Up to five users without replacement in each outcome x protocol train-support log bucket x positive-input-count stratum; most frequent recommendation-slot games added when present in a user's saved top four.

diagnostics.scope: Fixed validation cohort only; outcomes and recommendations are from saved v1 TF-IDF results. No v2 experiment ranking scores were computed.

selected_examples.contribution_definition: exact profile term weight × candidate TF-IDF term weight; profile is the L2-normalized equal mean of saved positive input game vectors; all shared positive terms are stored and sum to the saved v1 cosine score within 2e-5.
example_rows_include: top four saved recommendations and scores
input/target/wrong-candidate source, script profile, token count and duplicate group size

target_train_support_source_and_validati.source: train/positive_catalog.parquet, counted by distinct user-app rows with DuckDB (threads=2, memory_limit=1GB); matched against saved v1 target_train_support.

metadata_channel.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse and trim whitespace; preserve phrase text and punctuation; prefix tag:: or genre::; deduplicate concepts per game.
metadata_channel.precedence: A tags are chosen when they parse to a non-empty valid label list; C serialized tags are used only when A is missing, empty or invalid. C genres are a separate field.

resource_limits.max_rss_policy: less than 3GB; no dense all-pairs or user-by-candidate score matrix

item_knn.reason: No candidate met all predeclared adoption guards

artifact_audit.method: Independent DuckDB raw-edge shrinkage and ORDER BY; no reuse of builder ranking function

limitations: Same validation used to select among predeclared variants; bootstrap is not independent post-selection confirmation.
frank was previously observed; any reuse is reference only, never a new independent final test.

Game macro averages only target games observed in validation; low-support strata have small samples.
